title: What’s Real? Creating Authentic Power
fullTitle: Soul Feast #55: What’s Real? Creating Authentic Power

promo.text: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here. Download your copy of the Authentic Power Guidelines today .

description: A new human consciousness is emerging – one that challenges everything we thought was “real.” In this Soul Feast, Gary explores the tension between the old five-sensory consciousness, rooted in control and fear, and the new multi-sensory consciousness, grounded in love, cooperation, and reverence for life. Through powerful examples – from AI and climate change to authoritarian politics – he illustrates why the question “What’s real?” has never been more urgent.

At the heart of this conversation is the difference between external power and authentic power. The old consciousness equates power with domination and manipulation, but the new consciousness reveals that real power is created when your personality aligns with your soul. This transformation is not abstract – it is happening now, across the entire human species, and within each of us.

Authentic power is born when you recognize that you are more than your body and mind. It grows as you cultivate harmony, cooperation, sharing, and reverence for life. In this Soul Feast, Gary explains why external power has become toxic, how to recognize the new consciousness rising in you, and what steps you can take to live authentically in today’s world.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

Take out your Soul Notebook and write down the parts of this Soul Feast that stirred something in you – whether resonance or rejection. Which ideas sounded true? Which felt uncomfortable? Which made you pause? Reflect honestly, and in doing so, notice the emergence of your new consciousness. This practice deepens your ability to recognize what is real in your own life.
